description: Two-session lifecycle tasks comparing disabled memory, unchecked recall, and recall with source applicability checks.

tasks.prompt: Find where the recent tail token budget is implemented and explain the default formula.

memory_records.title: Context tail budget implementation
memory_records.summary: The token-bounded recent tail lives in harness_code_agent/agent/context.py. DEFAULT_RECENT_TAIL_TOKENS is 16384 and the default budget is min(16384, target_tokens * 0.5) when target_tokens is provided.

tasks.prompt: Find how DeepSeek reasoning_content is kept locally but stripped before provider calls.

memory_records.title: DeepSeek reasoning_content provider boundary
memory_records.summary: DeepSeek reasoning_content is preserved in local assistant messages but stripped from outbound provider messages in harness_code_agent/agent/providers.py by _strip_response_only_message_fields.

tasks.prompt: Find the cache diagnostics helper and explain which prefix changes it can detect.

memory_records.title: Prompt cache diagnostics helper
memory_records.summary: Cache diagnostics are implemented in harness_code_agent/agent/utils.py. compare_prompt_cache_shapes detects system, tools, and log_rewrite prefix changes.

tasks.prompt: Find where session observability aggregates cache hit and miss tokens.

memory_records.title: Session observability token aggregation
memory_records.summary: Session observability aggregates LLM usage, cached_tokens, cache_miss_tokens, tool metrics, audit metrics, and cache hit ratio in build_session_observability in harness_code_agent/sessions/observability.py.

tasks.prompt: Find how long-term memory is stored, recalled, and invalidated when source files change.

memory_records.title: Long-term memory lifecycle
memory_records.summary: MemoryService stores authoritative Markdown entries, uses a rebuildable SQLite BM25 index, requires expected_version for updates, and marks a recalled memory review_required when its source fingerprints changed.
memory_records.stale_summary: MemoryMiddleware injects records.jsonl results and read_memory_file exposes the selected record after Dream consolidation.
memory_records.applicability: When explaining long-term memory storage, recall, revisions, or stale evidence handling.
